business_problem: Ascendiv’s clients, including public sector agencies and financial institutions, faced fragmented data across multiple systems, inconsistent reporting, and limited executive visibility. Public sector organizations struggled to reliably evaluate service demand, throughput, and operational bottlenecks, constraining progress toward operational excellence and continuous improvement. The financial institutions’ data scattered across lending, finance, customer, and departmental systems was preventing a unified view of portfolio performance, market segments, and operational trends.
solution_summary: Ascendiv Sdn Bhd used Alibaba Cloud to address Ascendiv’s clients, including public sector agencies and financial institutions, faced fragmented data across multiple systems, inconsistent reporting, and limited executive visibility. Public sector organizations struggled to reliably evaluate service demand, throughput, and operational bottlenecks, constraining progress toward operational excellence and continuous improvement. The financial institutions’ data scattered across lending, finance, customer, and departmental systems was preventing a unified view of portfolio performance, market segments, and operational trends. Ascendiv Sdn Bhd is a Malaysia-based consulting firm built on a data-first philosophy, underpinned by its proprietary AI and data-first framework. The firm supports public service agencies and financial institutions in moving from manual, siloed decision-making to evidence-based management.

business_outcome: Unified BI Foundation: The solution established a unified business intelligence layer using Alibaba Cloud’s Quick BI Smart Q Solution, significantly increasing analytics productivity through automated dashboards and standardized reporting across departments. 50% Faster Reporting: Reduced the time and effort required for manual report preparation by approximately 50% by enabling self-service, natural-language analytics for both operational teams and management. Real-Time Public Sector Insights: Public sector clients’ leadership teams gained real-time visibility into service patterns, peak periods, and operational bottlenecks, enabling evidence-based interventions and clearer operational guidelines.
evidence_quotes: Ascendiv’s clients, including public sector agencies and financial institutions, faced fragmented data across multiple systems, inconsistent reporting, and limited executive visibility.
Public sector organizations struggled to reliably evaluate service demand, throughput, and operational bottlenecks, constraining progress toward operational excellence and continuous improvement.
The financial institutions’ data scattered across lending, finance, customer, and departmental systems was preventing a unified view of portfolio performance, market segments, and operational trends.

In both cases, the absence of a cohesive, enterprise-grade data foundation limited the strategic clarity, slowed reporting cycles, and made it difficult to consistently embed AI and analytics into decision-making processes.
Guided by its AI and data-first framework, Ascendiv implemented a layered architecture on Alibaba Cloud.
